mapper.select: SELECT se.semester_id, se.`year`, se.semester, c.credit, c.type, s.rank FROM score s JOIN enrollment e ON s.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id JOIN semester se ON c.semester_id = se.semester_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND se.semester_id != #{semesterId} ORDER BY se.`year` ASC, se.semester ASC
